Post-Quantum Security

Quantum computers pose a significant threat to current encryption standards. QuantumVault.pro employs post-quantum cryptographic algorithms that are designed to resist attacks from both classical and quantum computers.

  • NIST-approved post-quantum cryptographic algorithms
  • Multiple layers of encryption for defense-in-depth
  • Regular security updates to address emerging threats

Why Traditional Encryption Is at Risk

Most encryption today relies on mathematical problems that are difficult for classical computers to solve but can be easily broken by quantum computers. QuantumVault.pro uses algorithms specifically designed to resist quantum attacks.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does post-quantum encryption protect me?

Post-quantum encryption uses mathematical algorithms that are resistant to attacks from both classical and quantum computers, ensuring your data remains secure even when quantum computing becomes more accessible.

Is encrypted messaging really free forever?

Yes! Our basic encrypted messaging service is completely free with no time limits. We believe secure communication is a right, not a privilege.

What happens after my 14-day trial?

After your trial ends, you'll maintain access to free encrypted messaging, but will need to upgrade to a paid plan to continue using the file vault features.

Can I upgrade my plan later?

Absolutely! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time. Your files will remain accessible as long as they fit within your new storage limit.

Who can access my encrypted files and messages?

Only you and those you explicitly share with can access your encrypted content. Not even our team at QuantumVault.pro can access your encrypted data.

What devices is QuantumVault.pro compatible with?

QuantumVault.pro works on all major platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android, ensuring your secure data is accessible wherever you go.
